title: Regioselective Ru(II)-catalyzed C–H alkenylation and annulation of indoles: a direct approach to fused lactone scaffolds
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,30135-30145
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03671B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Jithender Rallabandi, Indrajit Shown
A new pathway to fused indole derivatives is provided by a Ru(II)-catalyzed C5–H alkenylation–annulation of indole-4-carboxylic acids, which permits regioselective lactone synthesis through a weakly coordinating carboxylic acid directing group.
